product.description: Monolith™ by Monoprice™Double‑Wide XL 3‑Tier AV StandThree‑shelf AV stand for your home theater or entertainment systemThe Monolith™ Double‑Wide XL 3‑Tier Stand is a three‑shelf AV stand for your home theater or entertainment system. Its large, wood finished shelves are sturdy and durable, while its open‑air design allows for maximum airflow for cooling and easy access to connections. Sturdy, tubular steel pillars provide incredible strength to support even the heaviest of components. The Monolith Double‑Wide XL 3‑Tier Stand is the perfect way to organize and display your AV components. STURDY CONSTRUCTIONMultiple support tubes feature a scratch‑resistant, powder‑coated finish, while the rigid, thick MDF shelves feature a finish that cleans easily and resists scratches and scuffing. Each shelf is acoustically inert and does a fantastic job of dampening vibrations. OPEN‑AIR DESIGNThe stand is designed with open‑air shelving for critical airflow, cooling, and ease of access to your components. Unlike most enclosed AV cabinets, this sturdy design ensures your equipment receives plenty of circulating air to prevent them from overheating during use. MODULAR DESIGNThe fully customizable, modular design lets you build your rack exactly as tall as needed. Start with the base and add as many of the shelves as you need.
